title: W5 Cutover: re-key posts, archive Space Circles, stop creating one per Space, update seeds

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-03: Space circles become a Community wall; thread plan /mnt/project-files/community-wall/PLAN.md

detail:
Re-key verified copies, archive every is_space_primary circle (status archived, slug kept for the redirect), drop the spaces_ensure_space_circle trigger and the auto-enrol triggers, point the-group, wildheart, menswork and free-human seeds at the Space. No post, reply, reaction or member is lost; a count check before and after is the gate. From W3 (2026-11-03): archiving the Space Circles is what removes them from listPublicSpaceCircles (LISTABLE_CIRCLE_STATUS), the Home circles block, Menswork finder and launch rows; check each after the archive. From W4 (2026-11-03): in the same change as the archive, 308 every archived Space Circle URL (/circles/<slug>, /discover/circles/<slug|id>) to its Space's /community page.

W5 cutover: migration 20270346029500 re-keys the 119 Space Circle events as Space events, keeps the Wildheart and Hearts on Fire founding circles as topic circles, unlinks the 7 Temple tiers, archives the rest and drops the creation and roster triggers; /circles/<slug> and /discover/circles/<slug|id> 308 to /spaces/<slug>/community; seeds place Space events.
